div.div: حَثْىٌ What is raised with the hand [to be poured, or to be thrown, or cast, therefrom; of dust; and also (assumed tropical:) of water]; (K, TA;) or, as in some copies of the K, with the two hands: and so [↓ حَثْوَةٌ and] ↓ حَثْيَةٌ ; [or rather these signify a single handful of dust, and (assumed tropical:) of water, raised to be poured or thrown;] pl. [حَثَواتٌ and] حَثَيَاتٌ. (TA.) See 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
